official_public_evidence.source: VT Markets LLC Best Execution Policy
official_public_evidence.finding: Requested price may be unavailable and execution can occur close to or several pips away; adverse slippage is normal under certain conditions.

official_public_evidence.source: VT Markets LLC Best Execution Policy
official_public_evidence.finding: Execution prices may vary significantly from requested prices during abnormal market conditions, including openings, major news, volatile markets and insufficient liquidity.

official_public_evidence.source: VT Markets LLC Best Execution Policy
official_public_evidence.finding: Execution depends on pricing and available liquidity from third-party liquidity providers.
Under market execution, if requested price is unavailable the order is filled at the best available market rate.

reason: Official execution policy explicitly allows state-dependent and potentially significant deviations but publishes no finite contractual maximum for NAS100.s market execution.
note_on_empirical_bounds: An observed sample maximum or percentile would not be a guaranteed future maximum under the frozen EXEC-03 invariants.
potential_future_route: A separately authorized bounded-execution policy or claim design may be proposed later, but EXEC-03 does not invent one.
